title: v1.2 更新公告
content:
## Bug 修复与体验改进

- 修复了编辑框在鼠标交互于框外结束时会触发关闭的问题
- 修正了长休的生命骰回复
- 修复了特性与法术注释弹窗可能因太长显示不全的问题，现在弹窗的位置不会超过角色卡边界

## 新功能

- 技能新增了1/2熟练的状态，按钮圆心显示为灰色
- 技能与豁免新增了用户自定义加值的功能，现在可以手动输入加值了（自定义值会覆盖计算，因此不会随属性调整值与熟练加值的改变而进行自动计算）
- 增加了公告弹窗，用于同步版本更新消息
- 增加了英语选项，但并未勘误（因为博主要去投稿黑客松了（想支持一下博主可以在6号和9号晚上来使用一下，帮忙刷刷网页浏览量！）

## 下版本更新计划

- 车卡指引文档博主奴役了亲友正在撰写中
- 亲友想要购点计算器，这个也打算做一下
contentEn:
## Bug Fixes & Improvements

- Fixed an issue where the edit dialog would close when mouse interaction ended outside the box
- Fixed Hit Dice recovery on Long Rest
- Fixed trait and spell tooltips being cut off when too long; tooltip position now stays within the character card boundary

## New Features

- Skills now support a half-proficiency state, indicated by a gray dot
- Skills and saving throws now support custom modifiers — you can manually enter a bonus (custom values override calculation and won't auto-update with attribute or proficiency changes)
- Added announcement popup for sharing version update news
- Added English language option (not fully proofread yet — the dev is submitting to a hackathon! If you'd like to support, feel free to visit on the evenings of the 6th and 9th to help boost page views!)

## Upcoming Plans

- Character building guide document is being drafted by friends (forced into labor by the dev)
- A point-buy calculator is also on the todo list
